scenes.title: The Ride That Stayed With Her
scenes.location: Gulmohar Heights · Tower C lift → Kapoor flat

blocks.text: Lift ka darwaaza band hua.

blocks.text: Uske chehre par ek muskurahat aa gayi.
*Uff... kya ride thi!*

*"Aur mujhe woh sab achha bhi laga..."*
Yeh sochkar woh khud hi hans padi.
Phir Babloo ka compliment yaad aaya.
*"Babloo bhi aaj bade confidence mein tha!"*
**Ding!**
Lift khuli.
Flat mein enter karte hi Ishita ki awaaz aayi.

blocks.text: **Ishita:** "Diii! Itni late? Aur car kahan hai?"

**Ishita:** "Arre! Kahan ja rahi ho?"
**Meenakshi:** "Garam shower lene. Aaj bahut lamba din tha!"
Bedroom mein pahunchkar uski nazar dressing-table ke drawer par padi.
Nikhil ke liye subah taiyaar kiya surprise abhi wahin tha.
Meenakshi muskuraayi.
*"Aur aaj ka din abhi khatam bhi kahan hua hai..."*

Garam shower lete hue Meenakshi ke dimaag mein din bhar ki baatein chal rahi thi. Uday aur Utkarsh ke saath woh unexpected ride, Babloo ka compliment, aur ab dressing-table ke drawer mein Nikhil ke liye rakha surprise.
Nikhil.
Uska naam sochte hi Meenakshi muskura di.

Meenakshi, 32, profession se doctor thi. Hospital mein uski personality confident aur decisive thi. Woh difficult situations mein bhi jaldi decisions le leti thi. Lekin ghar mein Nikhil ke saath uska ek alag hi andaaz tha.

Nikhil, 35, calm aur observant tha. Uska humour bhi bada understated tha. Kabhi itni serious shakal banakar teasing karta ki Meenakshi ko ek pal ke liye samajh hi nahi aata ki woh mazaak kar raha hai.
Shaadi ke shuruaati dino mein dono ko ek-doosre ko samajhne mein waqt laga tha.
Meenakshi ko Nikhil ki ek aadat bahut achhi lagti thi. Woh uske har silence ko problem nahi samajhta tha.
Ek baar usne poochha tha—
Meenakshi: "Tum har waqt itne shaant kaise rehte ho?"
Nikhil: "Kyunki meri wife hum dono ki taraf se bol leti hai."
Meenakshi: "Achha ji? Main bahut bolti hoon?"
Nikhil: "Maine aisa kab kaha, Doctor sahiba?"
Meenakshi hans padi thi.
Unki married life mein affection sirf daily conversations tak limited nahi tha. Kissing, mutual physical affection aur sexual intercourse bhi unke relationship ka natural hissa ban gaye the.

Meenakshi ke liye ek interesting contrast tha: medicine aur human anatomy ke baare mein uska professional knowledge bahut extensive tha, lekin apne husband ke saath personal desires express karna ek bilkul alag experience tha.

Nikhil bhi dheere-dheere uski personality ke dono sides samajhne laga tha—woh confident doctor jo kisi emergency mein nahi ghabrati, aur woh playful wife jo kabhi khud teasing shuru karti toh Nikhil ko bhi jawab sochna padta.
Unka marriage relationship sirf responsibility se nahi chal raha tha. Usmein friendship, attraction, intimacy aur ek-doosre ki aadaton ki familiarity bhi thi.
Phir Vihaan unki zindagi mein aaya.
Ab dedh saal ke Vihaan, hospital duties aur household responsibilities ke beech unka routine badal gaya tha.
Lekin Meenakshi ke liye motherhood ka matlab apni romantic personality ko chhod dena nahi tha.
Aaj woh Nikhil ke saath kuch special waqt bitana chahti thi.
Kisi argument ke baad reconciliation ke liye nahi. Na hi kisi ko kuch prove karne ke liye.
Bas kyunki uska khud ka mann tha.
Shower band karke woh bahar aayi.
